32
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, November 16, 2010/Kartika 25, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Finance; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Panchayati Raj; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Rural Development Shipping)
Total number of questions — 20
Funds allocated for rural development
in Orissa
*101. SHRIMATI RENUBALA
PRADHAN: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated by the Thirteenth
Finance Commission for rural development
in Orissa, component-wise; and
(b) the funds sanctioned for Orissa
under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
(PMGSY) in the current year alongwith
the funds so far released to the State and
the status of expenditure thereof?
 Pilot programme for expansion of
MGNREGS
*102. SHRI S. THANGA VELU: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the United Nations
Development Programme (UNDP) and
Government have launched a pilot
programme aimed at making the Mahatma
Gandhi National Rural Employment
Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS) more
efficient and effective by coordinating it
with other development programmes;
(b) whether the idea is to make the
coverage of this massive scheme better and
widen its impact;
(c) whether Government has also
invited proposals from NGOs and
professional institutions to initiate such a
project to strengthen the scheme as well as
bolster livelihood resources base of the rural
people; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Financial restructuring plan for
Air India
*103. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has proposed
a financial restructuring plan for the Air
India;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Ministry has decided
to monetise its land holdings and buildings
by outright sale or lease as part of the
restructuring plan; and
(d) if so, the details of land and buildings
identified for sale or lease?

33
 Review of existing protocols at
airports
*104. SHRIMATI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of protocols and
courtesies being observed by India and other
countries at airports, with particular
reference to the United States and the
United Kingdom;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
has proposed to review the existing
protocols and courtesies to VIPs of other
countries like USA, UK, etc.;
(c) whether India charges the visiting
VIPs for accessing our VIP lounges; and
(d) the details of countries which are
charging India for accessing their VIP
lounges, country-wise?
Evasion of tax in merger and
acquisition deals
*105. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of  FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
many cases of merger and acquisition deals
for possible tax evasion in the country, like
V odafone-Hutchison deal, that have come
under Government's scanner; and
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
the action proposed against such erring
companies by Government, so far?
 Functioning of ASHAs in Haryana
*106. SHRI SHADI LAL BATRA: Will
the Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has appointed
professionals to monitor National Rural
Health Mission (NRHM);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of Accredited Social
Health Activists (ASHAs) presently
working in the country, State-wise
particularly in the State of Haryana;
(d) whether any assessment has been
made in regard to the functioning of ASHAs;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof, and if not,
the reasons therefor?
 De-controlling prices of diesel
†*107. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of  PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
any proposal for decontrolling the price of
diesel;
(b) if so, by when any decision in this
regard is likely to be taken;
(c) whether the prices of diesel are likely
to increase after such decontrolling; and
(d) if so, whether all the sections of
people will be affected by price rise after
decontrolling the prices of diesel?
 Validity of entry cards issued by
BCAS
†*108. SHRI KAPTAN SINGH
SOLANKI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the validity period of cards
issued by the Bureau of Civil Aviation
Security (BCAS) to the concerned
employees and officers for their movement
at airports throughout the country has
lapsed;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has held
anyone responsible for this negligence; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

34
 Study on impact of MGNREGS on
Indian economy
*109. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: W ill the
Minister of  RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has undertaken
any systematic study on the impact of
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural
Employment Guarantee Scheme
(MGNREGS) on Indian economy;
(b) if so, the main findings of the said
study; and
(c) whether the Ministry has any plans
to include more items under the scheme?
 Ban on diabetes drug
*110. SHRI M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Rosiglitazone
drug used for treatment of diabetes causes
heart attack;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
European Union (EU), United Arab
Emirates (UAE) and United States of
America (USA) have banned this drug due
to its adverse implications;
(c) whether a Committee of Experts set
up in February, 2010 has recommended to
ban this drug; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons for not banning the drug so far?
 Financial position of ONGC
*111. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the reserves and surplus of the Oil
and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC)
during the last three years;
(b) the investment made by ONGC
during this period, year-wise; and
(c) the interest earned by ONGC on its
bank and cash balance, year-wise?
 Substitute medicines issued by
CGHS dispensaries
*112. SHRI A VTAR SINGH
KARIMPURI: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
Health Scheme (CGHS) dispensaries are
issuing substitute allopathic medicines in
place of the medicines prescribed by the
doctors;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether even for a single medicine
prescribed by the doctor, two or more
inappropriate substitutes are given; and
(d) if so, the remedial steps taken by
Government in this regard?
 Pricing of deregulated petroleum
products
*113. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NA TURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that at present
Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF), petrol and
diesel are deregulated products; and
(b) if so, whether import parity
principle is applicable for pricing of all
these products?
 Curbing population growth
*114. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the efforts made to curtail growth of
population and money spent thereon each
year during the last three years;
(b) the targets set and whether they
were achieved; and

35
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) if not, whether the need of
the hour is to resort to harsh measures
in  national  interest  to  curb  growth  of
population?
 Congestion and delays at Delhi and
Mumbai Airports
*115. DR. K.V . P. RAMACHANDRA
RAO: Will the Minister of  CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of domestic and
international flights being handled at
Mumbai and Delhi airports, respectively,
on an average every day;
(b) whether congestion and delays at
these airports, especially in the peak
morning and evening hours have been
noticed; and
(c) if so, the reasons for such congestion
and delays and the steps being taken in this
regard?
 Variations in consumer sale prices of
petroleum products
†*116. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there have
been variations in consumer sale prices of
petroleum products during the last six
months in the country;
(b) if so, the names of the petroleum
products, sale prices of which have declined
during this period;
(c) the names of the petroleum
products, the consumer sale prices of which
have increased; and
(d) the reasons for such voltality in the
sale prices of petroleum products?
 Review of working of MFIs
†*117. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that borrowers
have committed suicide recently due to
wrong methods of realization of debts used
by Micro Financing Institutions (MFIs) in
several States of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has
constituted a sub-committee to review the
working of MFIs; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Constitutional Amendments due to
GST
*118.DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether some States have asked the
Centre to drop two key provisions from
constitutional amendments suggested to
facilitate the proposed Goods and Services
Tax (GST);
(b) whether in a fresh proposal,
Chairman of the empowered committee of
State Finance Ministers has asked the
Centre to drop plans to create a joint council
of States and the Centre and a dispute
settlement body;
(c) if so, whether the Ministry has not
agreed to the suggestion;
(d) if so, whether all the hurdles to GST
in this regard have been removed; and
(e) if so, by what time a final decision in
this regard is likely to be taken?

36
 Deaths due to exposure to IAO in
rural areas
*119. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether as per a report of the World
Health Organisation (WHO) around five
lakh persons in India are killed every year
due to the pollution caused by burning of
wood, coal and dung in rural areas and
most of such victims are women and
children;
(b) whether India accounts for 80 per
cent of the six lakh premature deaths that
occur in this part of Asia, annually, due to
exposure to Irreversible Airway
Obstruction (IAO); and
(c) if so, the estimate of Government
thereto, and the steps being taken by
Government in this regard?
 Rising cases of food adulteration in
the country
*120. DR. JANARDHAN
WAGHMARE: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
cases of food adulteration are rising in the
country, particularly in the cities;
(b) if so, whether the Prevention of
Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and
amendments made therein have completely
failed to put a check on food adulteration;
(c) if so, whether the various State
Governments and eminent food experts
have urged the Central Government to
award death penalty to those who are
responsible for food adulteration in the
country; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government in
this regard?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 10th November, 2010 Secretary-General.
Kartika 19, 1932 (Saka)

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Civil Aviation : 103, 104, 108, 115,
Finance : 105, 117, 118,
Health and Family Welfare : 106, 110, 112, 114, 119, 120,
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises:—
Panchayati Raj :—
Petroleum and Natural Gas : 107, 111, 113, 116,
Rural Development : 101, 102, 109.
Shipping :—
GMGIPMRND—5019RS(S-3)—10.11.2010.
